When I first started I couldn't even stand. I feel your pain haha.

How I got better was simply practice. Wear your skates in the house on carpet and get accustomed to balancing while standing still and while rolling on 1 foot. You should be able to get your knee up high in front and bend behind.

So, think of transitions like you are opening a book and closing a book. A lot of new skaters toss in an extra step while learning or don't pick up their feet. For fuck sake...pick up your feet in a transition. Work off skates getting a feel for opening your hips and following through. Keep eyes up and focus on a spot on the wall (like dancers do in spins). Also...YouTube all the videos.

One-legged skating is a fantastic start! Work on turning your body sideways while maintaining your direction on one foot.
